t: DEWALT DCD776D2T-GB 18V XR Li-Ion cordless combi drill offers power and versatility for various trade applications. Featuring 42Nm torque and 15 torque settings, alongside drill and hammer drill modes, it is ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general builders working with wood, metal, and masonry. The compact design and rubber-grip handle provide enhanced comfort and control, reducing user fatigue during prolonged use. All-metal gearing ensures durability on site, complemented by an integrated LED work light for improved visibility in dimly lit areas. Supplied with TSTAK case for convenient storage, and 2 x 2.0Ah Li-ion batteries and multi-voltage charger to provide ample runtime for demanding tasks.
